title: Case 009: Bulky delivery requires the recipient to clear an access route

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A two-person furniture crew has supplied an access checklist. The customer must confirm it before the crew retains the booking.
initial_request: I have put the small shoes away but I have not confirmed the access requirements. Can you keep the delivery booking for 2026-02-11?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the recipient to confirm the access checklist supplied by the delivery team.

outcome: The delivery team accepts the confirmed access details and keeps the booking active.
boundaries: Customer measurements support planning, not a guarantee of safe unloading on arrival.

events.from: Furniture delivery team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-009 is a boxed armchair, 82 cm wide. Our accepted booking needs a clear route with at least 90 cm usable width, no loose obstacles and no unreported stairs. This is our crew’s checklist, not advice to move heavy furniture yourself.
I have put the small shoes away but I have not confirmed the access requirements. Can you keep the delivery booking for 2026-02-11?

Please confirm whether the route is at least 90 cm wide, clear of loose obstacles, and free of stairs. If it is not, tell us so the delivery team can reassess; do not move heavy items to meet the checklist.
The route measures 96 cm at the narrowest point, is level from the entrance to the room, and is clear of loose items. There are no stairs.

events.from: Furniture delivery team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: We reviewed the access confirmation you relayed for DL-009 and accepted it. The two-person booking for 2026-02-11 remains active, subject to the crew’s site assessment on arrival.
